title: What is Capybaroar?
text: Capybaroar is an agentic social media platform: an AI agent plans and writes your posts, and you schedule them to 12 networks from one calendar. What you can do Calendar: plan, write and schedule posts for every channel in one place, with a preview for each network. Agents: ask for a week of posts in one message. The agent writes them as drafts for you to check. Inbox: answer comments and mentions from your channels without switching apps. Analytics and Reports: see reach, engagement and your best times to post, then share a report. Link in bio: one page for every link you share. MCP and API: use Capybaroar from Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor, or from your own code. The 12 networks Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, LinkedIn profiles, LinkedIn Pages, YouTube, X, Threads, Pinterest, Bluesky, Mastodon and Discord. Each one has its own page in these docs with what you can post and how to connect it. Plans The Free plan covers 3 channels and 30 scheduled posts a month for 1 person. Creator, Pro and Agency add more channels, AI credits, teammates, brands and approvals. New accounts get 14 days of Pro free, with no card needed. See Pricing for every limit. Where to start Create your account Connect your first channel Schedule your first post

title: Create your account
text: Sign up with your email in under a minute. You start on 14 days of Pro, free, with no card. Steps Open the sign-up page. Go to app.capybaroar.com/signup . Fill in the form. Enter your name, company, email and a password, then press Create account . Follow the welcome steps. The welcome screen walks you through two things: Connect a channel and Schedule a post . Your free trial New workspaces get 14 days of Pro with 200 AI credits. You don't need a card. When the trial ends you move to the Free plan unless you pick a paid plan, and your posts and channels stay where they are. Inviting your team Pro includes 5 members and Agency includes 15. Clients who only approve posts don't take a seat. Invite people from Settings .

title: Connect your first channel
text: A channel is one social account Capybaroar can post to, like your Instagram account or your LinkedIn Page. Steps Open Channels. Click Channels in the sidebar. Pick a network. Click the network you want to add. Sign in and approve. Most networks open their own sign-in page. Sign in with the account you post from and approve Capybaroar. Bluesky and Discord ask for details in a short form instead. Check it's connected. You land back on Channels, and the new channel shows as Connected . Post to it from the calendar. How each network connects Network How you connect Instagram , Facebook , Threads Sign in with Meta TikTok Sign in with TikTok LinkedIn Sign in with LinkedIn, for your profile or a Page you manage YouTube Sign in with the Google account that owns the channel X , Pinterest Sign in with that network Mastodon Type your server, then sign in there Bluesky Your handle and an app password Discord A webhook link for the channel When a channel says Reconnect Networks sign apps out from time to time, for example after a password change. Click Reconnect on the channel and sign in again. Scheduled posts stay in place. How many channels you can add Free covers 3 channels, Creator 8, Pro 30 and Agency 100.

title: Schedule your first post
text: Write a post once, check how it looks on each network, then schedule it, queue it or post it now. Steps Open the calendar. Click Calendar , then New post . Pick channels. Choose one or more connected channels at the top of the editor. Write your post. Type your text. The counter shows how much room each network has left. Add pictures or a video. Upload files or pick them from your media. Some networks need media, like Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and Pinterest. Set network options. Click a channel's tab to change things for that network only, like an Instagram Reel, a YouTube title or a Pinterest board. You can also change the text for one network. Check the preview. The right side shows how the post will look on each network. Click a video to play it. Choose when it goes out. Schedule: pick a date and time. Add to queue: put it in your next open queue time. Post now: publish right away. Save draft: keep it for later. After it posts Open the post again from the calendar to see each channel's result. When a network gives Capybaroar the post's address, an Open post link shows next to that channel. If a network turns a post down, its reason shows in the same place. Tips Use a first comment on Instagram, Facebook and LinkedIn for links or hashtags. Upload many posts at once with Bulk in the calendar. Let the agent write a whole week of drafts, then edit and schedule them here.

title: Instagram
text: How to connect Instagram, what you can post there and how to fix a post it turns down. At a glance Characters 2,200 Needs a picture or video Yes Connects with Sign-in Inbox Comments and mentions: answer and hide Analytics Reach and engagement for each post in Analytics Connect Instagram Click Instagram in Channels and sign in with Meta. Pick the Instagram account you post from and approve Capybaroar. Post to Instagram Open the calendar and click New post . Pick your Instagram channel and write the post. Open the Instagram tab to set the options below. Check the preview , then schedule, queue or post now. Instagram only lets apps post to professional accounts (business or creator). You can switch for free in the Instagram app under account settings. A post needs at least one picture or video. A Reel is one video, and a Story is one picture or video. A post takes up to 10 files, which Instagram shows as a carousel. Add a cover for a Reel from its tab, and a first comment for hashtags or links. Instagram settings Format Post, Reel, Story (starts as Post) Reel cover (for Reels only) First comment Posted as a comment right after the post If a post is turned down Capybaroar checks each post before it's scheduled and shows the reason next to the channel. These are the Instagram ones: Message What to do Instagram needs a picture or video Add a picture or video. Instagram doesn't take text-only posts. An Instagram Reel is one video Remove extra files, or set the format back to Post. An Instagram Story is one picture or video Keep one file for a Story. Instagram takes up to 10 files Remove files until there are 10 or fewer. Read more about scheduling Instagram on the Instagram scheduler page.

title: TikTok
text: How to connect TikTok, what you can post there and how to fix a post it turns down. At a glance Characters 2,200 Needs a picture or video Yes Connects with Sign-in Inbox Not in the Inbox Analytics Not in Analytics yet Connect TikTok Click TikTok in Channels, sign in with TikTok and approve Capybaroar. TikTok always shows its approval page, with Switch account if you want a different account. Post to TikTok Open the calendar and click New post . Pick your TikTok channel and write the post. Open the TikTok tab to set the options below. Check the preview , then schedule, queue or post now. Every TikTok post is one video, with a caption of up to 2,200 characters. The TikTok tab shows the account you post as, and the Who can watch choices TikTok allows for it. Pick one: there is no default. Allow comments, Duet and Stitch start off. Turn on the ones you want. If your TikTok settings turn one off, it stays off here too. Mark promotional posts as Your brand or Branded content. TikTok labels them, and branded content can't be set to Only me. After it posts, TikTok may take a few minutes to process the video before it shows on your profile. Disconnecting TikTok in Capybaroar also removes Capybaroar's access on TikTok. TikTok settings Who can watch Everyone, Friends, Followers, Only me (required) Allow comments On, Off (starts as Off) Allow Duet On, Off (starts as Off) Allow Stitch On, Off (starts as Off) Promotional content No, Your brand, Branded content (starts as Off) If a post is turned down Capybaroar checks each post before it's scheduled and shows the reason next to the channel. These are the TikTok ones: Message What to do TikTok needs exactly one video Use one video and no pictures. Choose who can watch this TikTok Pick an option in Who can watch. Branded content can't be set to Only me on TikTok Pick a wider audience, or set Promotional content to Your brand or No. This TikTok account can't post with that Who can watch choice. title: X (Twitter)
text: How to connect X (Twitter), what you can post there and how to fix a post it turns down. If a post is turned down Capybaroar checks each post before it's scheduled and shows the reason next to the channel. These are the X (Twitter) ones: Message What to do X posts are up to 280 characters Shorten the text in the X tab. X takes up to 4 pictures, or one video or GIF Remove files until you have up to 4 pictures, or one video or GIF. X posts need text or media Add text or a file. These are the Discord ones: Message What to do This Discord webhook doesn't exist or was deleted Make a new webhook in Discord and connect it again. title: The AI agent
text: The agent is Claude with every Capybaroar action. Tell it what you need and it plans and writes posts, makes pictures and checks your results. What the agent can do Look at your channels and recent posts, then plan and write new ones. Save posts as drafts at your queue times, or schedule them when you ask. Make pictures and videos for posts and attach them when they're ready. Read your analytics and tell you which posts did best. Edit or delete posts. It asks before deleting. It uses the same actions and checks you do, so it can't go past your plan's limits or post to a channel you can't use. Start a chat Open Agents. Click Agents in the sidebar, then New chat . Say what you want. For example: "Plan next week for our bakery launch: one LinkedIn post a day, Monday to Friday at 10 AM. Save them as drafts." Check the drafts. The agent tells you what it saved. Open them in the calendar to edit, then schedule. Drafts first The agent saves drafts unless you ask it to schedule. Nothing goes out until you, or the agent on your request, schedule it. What it costs The agent is on paid plans and uses AI credits . Each message costs what it really used, with a small minimum. Pictures and videos it makes are charged on their own.

title: Plan a week of posts with the agent
text: One message, five days of drafts. Here is how to ask so the first try is close to right. Steps Open a new chat in Agents . Give the topic and the goal. "We're launching a sourdough class on the 20th. Get sign-ups." Name the channels and the rhythm. "One LinkedIn post and one Instagram post a day, Monday to Friday." Say when. "At my queue times" or "at 9 AM New York time". Say what to save. "Save them as drafts." The agent saves drafts by default anyway. Review in the calendar. Open each draft, tweak it, check the preview and schedule. Prompts to copy "Look at my channels and recent posts, then write a week of posts about [topic]. Save them as drafts at my next queue times." "Turn this article into a LinkedIn post and an X post, and save both as drafts: [link]" "Make a picture for each draft this week and attach it." "Show my results for the last 30 days and tell me which posts did best." Getting better results Paste a few of your best past posts so it can match your voice. Give facts it can't guess: prices, dates, names and links. Ask for changes in the same chat: "Make Wednesday's shorter and add a question."

title: AI credits
text: Everything AI in Capybaroar draws from one credit balance: the agent, writing help, pictures, videos and voiceovers. Credits on each plan Plan AI credits a month Free – Creator 1,000 Pro 2,500 Agency 8,000 Pro trial (14 days) 200 Plan credits refill on your billing date each month, on yearly plans too. Unused ones don't carry over. What things cost Rewrite, fit to a network, suggested reply or caption: 4 credits. Build a link in bio page with AI: 50 credits. An agent message: what it really used, at least 2 credits. Long jobs, like a week of posts with pictures, use more. Pictures and videos: priced by the model and length. A short video costs the most. 1,000 credits make about 125 images, or about 6 weeks of posts planned by the agent. If something fails, you get its credits back. Buying more On a paid plan you can buy packs: 1,000 credits for $12, 5,000 for $50 or 20,000 for $160. Bought credits last 12 months and are used after your plan credits. You can also turn on automatic top-up, which buys a pack when your balance gets low. Limits per client On Agency you can cap how many credits each client brand uses a month, so one client can't use up the whole pool.

title: Rewrite and fit posts with AI
text: In the post editor, AI can rewrite your text, fit it to each network and suggest replies in the Inbox. Rewrite a post Open a post in the calendar, or click New post . Write a first version , even a rough one. Press Rewrite in the text toolbar, or Ctrl+J, and keep the version you like. Fit to each network One post rarely fits every network as is. X has 280 characters and LinkedIn has 3,000. Open a channel's tab and change the text for that network only, or ask AI to fit it. Each network's preview updates as you go. Suggested replies in the Inbox In the Inbox , open a comment and press Suggest reply . Edit the draft and send it. What it costs Each rewrite, fit, caption or suggested reply costs 4 AI credits . AI writing is on paid plans.

title: Use Capybaroar from Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor
text: Capybaroar has an MCP server, so the AI you already use can plan, write and schedule posts in your account. It is on every plan, Free too. Claude: sign in Claude connects with your Capybaroar sign-in, so there is no key to copy. In Claude, open Settings , then Connectors . Press Add custom connector , name it Capybaroar and paste https://app.capybaroar.com/api/mcp Press Connect , sign in to Capybaroar, pick the workspace and press Allow . Start a new chat. In Claude Code, run this and sign in when it asks: claude mcp add --transport http capybaroar https://app.capybaroar.com/api/mcp Apps you connect this way are listed in Settings , API and MCP , under Connected apps . Press Remove to cut one off. Other apps: copy your MCP link In Capybaroar, open Settings , then API and MCP . Press New key and copy the MCP link . It looks like https://app.capybaroar.com/api/mcp/cbr_... Keep the link private. Anyone with it can post as you. You only see it once, so make a new key if you lose it. ChatGPT Open Settings , then Apps and Connectors . Under Advanced , turn on Developer mode . This needs a paid ChatGPT plan. Press Create , name it Capybaroar and paste your link. In a new chat, open + and pick Capybaroar. Cursor Open Cursor Settings , then MCP , press Add new MCP server and paste this with your link: { "mcpServers": { "capybaroar": { "url": "https://app.capybaroar.com/api/mcp/cbr_your_key" } } } Try it "Use Capybaroar. Look at my channels and recent posts, then write a week of posts about [topic]. Save them as drafts at my next queue times." "Use Capybaroar. List everything scheduled for this week." "Use Capybaroar. Show my results for the last 30 days and tell me which posts did best." What your AI can do List channels, brands and channel groups; create, update, list and delete posts; find the next queue time; upload and list media; make pictures and videos (with an MCP link); read analytics and credits; and manage webhooks. The API docs list every action in detail.
